folds.assignment: first eight SHA-256 bytes of group_id, big-endian, modulo fold count
folds.unit: board group; all four range families remain together

objective.primary: aggregate raw exploitability reduction from checkpoint zero
objective.state_work_constraint: candidate cumulative alternating state visits cannot exceed fixed checkpoint four
objective.timing_replicate: aggregate raw reduction per charged measured millisecond

rank_transform.definition: average ranks within the current allocation pool, scaled to [0,1] with larger directed values better
rank_transform.score: weighted arithmetic mean of term ranks
rank_transform.ties: average rank; allocation ties break by context_id

allocator.definition: start every context at checkpoint four; consider at most floor(pool size times maximum recipient fraction) highest-scored recipients; fund each promotion by demoting lowest-scored nonrecipients to checkpoint two until both iteration and deterministic state-visit credits cover it; restore unnecessary highest-scored donors; never exceed either fixed budget

selection.candidate_family: Cartesian product of six frozen scores and five frozen macros, plus fixed checkpoint four
selection.development_choice: maximum aggregate raw exploitability uplift over fixed checkpoint four; candidate_id breaks tolerance ties
selection.evaluation: for each held-out fold choose on the other four folds, then evaluate once on the untouched fold

runtime_charging.active_score: charge measured one-pass active regret summary and measured allocator time
runtime_charging.shadow_score: also charge max(0, paired shadowed probe time minus plain probe time) and the measured active-plus-shadow summary

post_gate.failure: retain fixed checkpoint-four DCFR and do not construct reserved contexts
post_gate.pass: freeze the all-development selected candidate in a new committed rule before constructing validation or test contexts
